title.narrative: Strengthening CSOs as inclusive actors of good governance and development in Sierra Leone

description.narrative: The action fully contributes to the global objective of this call to `strengthen local CSOs¿ engagement as actors of good governance and development in Sierra Leone¿, specifically in relation to youth, women, vulnerable and marginalised people (lot 1). The action builds on the lead MAPCO and co-applicants MUWODA and APT¿s experience of highly collaborative and impactful EU actions strengthening local CSOs under the CSO-LA programme in Kenema (45 CSOs 2018-21) and Pujehun (19 CBOs 2019-22). Combining the experience of MAPCO and MUWODA, a women-led organisation, this action builds on the gains made in the districts and chiefdoms, targeting primarily new CSOs (representing women, youth and PWD) in chiefdoms previously worked in; improving the capacity of CSOs to sustain themselves, engage with and make demands of local customary and state authorities, and ensure equal representation of women, youth and PWD. With a specific objective of `Strengthened CSOs¿ engagement as inclusive actors of good governance and development in Pujehun and Kenema Districts, with improved capacity to work collectively as a coordinated civil society network and to sustainably meet and represent the needs of marginalised groups¿, the action is closely aligned to SO3 of this call: Strengthened capacity of local CSOs to engage in gender equality, youth inclusion and strengthened capacity of local women¿s and youth partner CSOs. It also contributes to building the capacity of local CSOs to promote an enabling environment at local levels (SO2) through which influence can be achieved.
